name: unit-claim
description: Before a team AI-DLC Unit is claimed, one dialog asks which design stages run and the approval rhythm (unit-end or per-stage), with a model's recommendation per stage drawn above it. Typed answers are resolved by a model and refused when unclear. A hook refuses the claim until it is answered, claims with the chosen rhythm, and skips the left-out stages for that Unit only.

recommendModel.title: Recommendation model
recommendModel.description: Full model id that reads the Unit's entry, its stories and each design stage's condition, and recommends which stages run, with a reason each.

resolveModel.title: Answer resolver model
resolveModel.description: Full model id that reads stage names or a rhythm the developer typed instead of picking an option, allowing for typos; an unclear answer is refused and asked again.
